# m.stocks.filings.disclosures_8k

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Disclosures in 8-K current reports, classified by category, one row per disclosure.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.disclosures_8k(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.APPEND`, which appends each row it hasn't seen, identified by `AccessionNumber`, `PrimaryCategory`, `SecondaryCategory`, `TertiaryCategory`, `SupportingText` and `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers whose filings to return; None, the default, for every filing. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first filing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last filing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"filing_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"tertiary_category": "Dividends"}`. Keys: `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `tertiary_category`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Material Event Disclosures (8-K) (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | Unique SEC accession number for the filing (e.g., '0000320193-25-000010'). |
| `Cik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the filer (10 digits, zero-padded). |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the full submission text file for the filing on SEC EDGAR. |
| `PrimaryCategory` | String | Top-level disclosure category (e.g., 'financial_results'). See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. |
| `SecondaryCategory` | String | Mid-level disclosure category (e.g., 'earnings_announcement'). See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. |
| `SupportingText` | String | A verbatim excerpt from the filing text supporting the assigned categories. |
| `TertiaryCategory` | String | Most specific disclosure category (e.g., 'quarterly_results'). Filtering on this column must use an exact match. See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. |
| `Tickers` | String[] | A list of ticker symbols for the filing company. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes; empty if no ticker is currently mapped to the filer. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
